scope: Annotation inventory plus explicit simulation candidates; not all biological sensory transduction is solved.

status_meaning.ready: Evidence-backed anatomical input available; physical encoding still uncalibrated.
status_meaning.candidate: Anatomical target present; selectivity, body localization or physical encoding incomplete.
status_meaning.unmapped: Cannot safely assign an executable functional channel or known entry side.

side_definition.FlyWire v783: Sensory side in annotation paper is the peripheral nerve entry side.
side_definition.MaleCNS v1.0: rootSide; never somaSide or arbitrary array splitting.
side_definition.bilateral: Union of known left/right/central peripheral entries; unknown entries excluded.

encoding_assumptions.intensity: Dimensionless multiplier in [0,2], not physical concentration/force/lux.
encoding_assumptions.overlap: Overlapping input rates sum per neuron and time bin; no duplicate spikes per bin.
encoding_assumptions.visual: 10 Hz LIF event proxy for graded receptor activity; no pixel/image encoder.
encoding_assumptions.timing: 0.1 ms bins; default onset 50 ms, duration 300 ms; inputs 50..2000 ms and onset 0..4000 ms; window extends 100 ms beyond final input, at most 5000 ms; profiles uncalibrated.
